component.name: Plasma Visual Screensaver
component.summary: A non-locking visual screensaver for Plasma Wayland

description.p: Displays low-resource animated visuals and a clock across every monitor after a configurable idle interval.
This application is decorative and is not a security boundary.

Adds glowing hexagon power-ups to Slithering Snakes, with one effect at a time: Surge gives free, back-to-back boosts and a faster snake for chained attacks; Magnet pulls in food from three times as far; Phase lets snakes slip through rivals' bodies until it wears off. Turn power-ups off in Settings.
Snakes seek power-ups to hunt, scavenge and escape. Crackling arcs, an orbiting magnet ring and a translucent hologram show each effect.
Prefers Vulkan to stop steady memory growth on NVIDIA GPUs under Plasma Wayland. OpenGL remains available with PVS_GRAPHICS_API=opengl or --graphics-api opengl.

Gives Slithering Snakes glossy, shaded, glowing bodies with pointed tails, chevrons, saddle bands and glowing spine lights on the biggest snakes. Adds spade-shaped heads with eyes that follow movement, blinking, tongue flicks and a gold crown for the leader.

Adds new food sprites, boost bow waves and contrails, sparks on kills and bodies that dissolve into shards. Collisions follow the tapered body. A soft shadow keeps the clock readable over busy scenes. Reduces rendering cost and keeps the previous look as an automatic fallback on systems without shader support.

Gives Slithering Snakes short boosts for cut-offs, escapes and food races. Each boost costs tail segments dropped as edible pellets and needs time to cool down. Hunts are faster and more decisive, with fewer self-inflicted deaths.

Adds brighter boosting snakes and contrails, amber hunting eyes, pinprick trapped pupils, kill flashes and fading corpses. The leader's crown changes hands only when clearly overtaken. Moves snake drawing into the Rust core to reduce rendering cost.
Noticeably reduces Slithering Snakes CPU use by rebuilding snake bodies more efficiently and skipping redundant AI work. Snake behavior stays the same, with steadier frame timing.

Makes Slithering Snakes hunt rivals, predicting their movement from what they can see and reacting at individual speeds. Bursts of speed let snakes cut across rivals' paths, and long snakes can trap smaller ones against walls.
More snakes are taken out by rivals, with fewer self-inflicted deaths and no deaths from hitting walls, at the same low CPU cost.

Paces each display at the highest rate up to the configured FPS that divides its refresh rate evenly, removing judder on mixed-refresh setups. Synchronized and seamless visuals keep one shared simulation sampled by each display, and shared Bounce physics keeps synchronized monitors in step.
Positions overlays correctly when panels are not covered and repaints paused and reduced-motion visuals when their state changes.

Moves Slithering Snakes simulation and AI to Rust, reducing CPU use and improving pathfinding, collision avoidance, and open-space awareness. Bigger snakes contest food and cut rivals off, while smaller snakes avoid losing head-on encounters.
Keeps synchronized and seamless snake worlds alive across monitor removal and aligns frame pacing with display refresh for steadier animation across all visuals.
Reliably re-arms idle activation after overlay dismissal on Plasma Wayland and preserves recovery when the active monitor layout disappears.
Moves Fireflies to a batched native scene-graph renderer, preserving its visual controls while cutting multi-monitor CPU and GPU usage and improving frame pacing.
Reclaims fullscreen rendering memory after dismissal and improves Slithering Snakes with steadier food pursuit, curved rival prediction, safer self-escape behavior, and expanded long-run tests.
Adds preview path diagnostics and improves Slithering Snakes with stable 360-degree turn-aware food targeting, anti-orbit recovery, safer predictive pursuit, and expanded long-run benchmarks.
Greatly reduces Slithering Snakes CPU and GPU load, keeps mature ecosystems stable, fixes food detail-size changes, and adds reliable version and update controls.
Improves Slithering Snakes with exact path-following bodies, faster predictive safety decisions, persistent food vacuuming, and continuous swept collision detection.
Adds the optimized Slithering Snakes ecosystem, richer animation controls, and seamless multi-monitor state preservation.
